text.title: MLP Planning Procedure
text.summary: Step-by-step procedure for applying mlp planning end-to-end. Then: Five-step process for planning the gap between a validated MVP and a Minimum Lovable Product.

step.name: audit-layers
step.action: Score each of the 4 layers 0-5 with cited evidence.
step.decision-gate: If any layer score has no evidence, re-audit before continuing.

step.name: gate-base
step.action: If functional or reliable <3, block delight backlog and route to bug-fixing.
step.decision-gate: If base broken, exit MLP path until base >=3.

step.name: build-delight-backlog
step.action: Use sonnet to draft delight items; each requires >=1 verbatim quote.
step.decision-gate: If any item lacks a quote, reject.

step.name: sprint
step.action: Run a bounded delight sprint (<=14d, single theme); measure delta against target.
step.decision-gate: If window closes with no retention delta, return to audit; do not chain sprints blindly.

step.name: audit-your-mvp
step.input: Core feature list + layer definitions (rules layer-1-functional to layer-4-delightful)
step.action: Apply rule audit-each-feature-all-layers: rate every core feature 1–5 on all four layers.
step.decision-gate: Any feature below 4 on any layer is an open gap; carry it to step 10.

step.name: identify-delight-opportunities
step.action: Apply rule scan-four-delight-moments across onboarding, core action, success and recovery moments; classify candidates by the five delight types listed in 05-examples.xml.

step.name: prioritize-polish
step.input: Delight opportunity list + usage frequency data
step.action: Apply rule polish-only-high-frequency-high-visibility: order by user pain × frequency × visibility.

step.name: define-mlp-criteria
step.action: Apply rule explicit-mlp-criteria-per-segment using its template sentence.
step.output: Written MLP criteria with verification method.
step.decision-gate: If any layer's criterion has no measurable outcome, rewrite before continuing.

step.name: plan-the-gap
step.action: Apply rule gap-analysis-per-feature: document current state, MLP target, what is missing, and effort per feature.
